description: Temp. Reg. § 15a.453-1(b)(5) Example (3): the same sale with a basis of $40,000. 'In the year of the sale C is deemed to have received payment of $20,000 ($60,000−$40,000 ...) ... the gross profit ratio is 1 ($120,000/$120,000) and C will report 100% of the $20,000 deemed payment in the year of sale and each $10,000 annual payment as gain'. With one $10,000 payment in the year of sale: $30,000.
